Set code type context

Source: R/with_type.R
with_type.Rd

with_type() temporarily sets the active code type so that query functions inside code use it without needing an explicit type = argument. It works with any code type present in the database.

Usage

with_type(type, code)

Arguments

type

A string naming the code type (e.g. "ICD-10", "SNOMED CT"). This corresponds to the type argument accepted by query functions such as CODES(), CHILDREN(), and MAP().

code

The expression to evaluate within the code type context.

Value

The result of evaluating code.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
with_type("ICD-10", DESCRIPTION("diabetes"))
with_type("BNF", CODES("0204 << Beta-Adrenoceptor Blocking Drugs >>"))
with_type(
  "SNOMED CT",
  CHILDREN(
    "770765001 << Proliferative retinopathy of right eye due to diabetes mellitus (disorder) >>"
  )
)
} # }
